375. Min Cost to Make Subarray 0 or 1

60

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Jack is playing with an array A of N numbers. Each number in the array is either 0 or 1 Replacing a 0 with 1 costs X rupees. Replacing a 1 with 0 costs Y rupees. Jack is given Q queries of the form L R where he wants to know what is the minimum cost to make the subarray A[L] , A[L+1] , A[L+2] .... A[R] such that all elements are 0 or all elements are 1. Help him solve this problem.
input_spec: The first line contains a single integer N representing the size of the array The second line contains N integers each of which is 0 or 1 The third line contains a single integer Q - the number of questions The next Q lines consist of a four integers L R X Y each representing the query for range L,R and the cost of replacement for that query
output_spec: The output must consist of Q lines each of which contains a single integer-the answer to the corresponding query.
